name: Challenge an existing investment thesis
summary: A planned research capability for adversarial review of an existing investment thesis.

discovery_contract.user_job: Identify disconfirming evidence, hidden assumptions, key unknowns, invalidation conditions and next verification steps for an existing investment thesis.
use_when: The user wants an adversarial review rather than confirmation.
do_not_use_when: The request is for an unconditional buy or sell instruction.
The request requires personalized trade execution.
There is no thesis or decision context to review.

known_limitations: No public evaluation set has been released.
Coverage, data sources and operating rights are not yet locked.
The capability may produce generic counterarguments until differentiated performance is demonstrated.

availability_note: No public API or MCP endpoint is available.
